comment: A track loop of 44 links (examples/cad/track_link.step) around the drive sprocket (sprocket.step) and the idler (idler.step), resting on the ground, the sprocket driven at 1 rad/s by a PID controller: contact on the exact STEP surfaces. The wheels, 5 track rollers (track_roller.step) and a carrier roller (carrier_roller.step) are on the track frame of half of a 20 t excavator (10000 kg), on a float joint, held up only by the track on the ground, so the sprocket drives it along. The contacts wear (Archard), and the track module logs the sag of the top spans, the misguide of the links and the side force on the flanges. A benchmark, not run in the regular tests. x forward, y to the right, z down: the axles along y, the idler in front of the sprocket. Written by scripts/make_track_step.py.
